contexts.text: That nettle, etc. = such things (as curse and vastation). Illustrated.
A place left to the nettle () = vastated good. ( = the ardour and burning of the life of man from the love of self. AC 10300:6.)
How can a nettle be converted into a vine... BE 112. TCR 642.
With those in Hell... there grow nettles, etc.
The devastation of all good is signified by a place of a nettle ().
